verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships first-party AI for natural-language infrastructure work. The official MCP server lets AI coding assistants such as Cursor and Claude Code "generate infrastructure code" and delegate tasks to Neo. Neo accepts plain-English requests ("Tell Neo what you need in plain English", e.g. "Give me a VPC with a subnet in every AZ") and is positioned as AI built into the platform. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the code-generation workflow itself (languages output, review/edit loop, CLI-native generation), and independent or hands-on corroboration that generated code is reliable.
